events.text: At 7:00 p.m. at Tri-Valley Freight’s Central Valley distribution yard, two refrigerated trucks arrive at once, and only Door 6 has a working dock seal. One driver is close to his hours-of-service limit and wants to drop the trailer and leave.
events.title: Two trucks, one door

events.text: During the night shift at Tri-Valley Freight, Darnell’s cycle count shows 14 pallets of almonds missing from a lane the inventory system says is full. A customer pickup for those pallets is scheduled at midnight, and nobody has touched the lane since the previous shift.
events.title: The count is off

events.text: On a hot night at Tri-Valley Freight’s Central Valley dock, the thermometer reads 104°F and the forecast calls for even higher temperatures. Two temps in their first week are skipping water breaks to keep up with the line rate set earlier in the shift.
events.title: Heat on the dock
